name: Supplemental OMM Orbit Determination
description: Signed isomorphic graph: one WASM timer policy fans typed ticks to five independent provider nodes; provider FSB ephemerides feed an independent OD node; fitted FSB records reach independently signed FlatSQL, publication, and status nodes. Hosts expose only application-blind capabilities and never own schedule, storage, status, or publication policy.
